This course runs **August 24 – December 9, 2026**, meeting **Mondays and Wednesdays**. Mondays use lecture to the week's concepts; **Wednesdays are in-class group case write-ups, which are turned in at the end of class** — come having done the reading.

::: {.info-box}
### {{< fa book >}} Readings & course pack
Readings marked **©** are in the Harvard Business Publishing course pack; all others are on Canvas or linked directly. Complete each reading **before** the day they are listed.
:::
